systemMessage: Combat Writing: Node is not on the PATH, so the plugin cannot run: its commands and its hooks are Node scripts. Nothing of your own work is stopped; only a Combat Writing reader is not started. Install Node and start a new session, or turn the plugin off with /plugin.

hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext: Combat Writing is installed, but Node is not on the PATH, so none of its scripts or hooks can run in this session. When the person asks for a /cw: command, say that Node must be installed first and a new session started; run no script of the plugin and start no cw:seat agent.
